Interaction between Verapamil and Curculigoside in Rats
GENG Chuan-rong1 , SUN Jin-rui1 , DENG Yu-xiao1 , ZHANG Bin2 , ZHAO Si-tai1 , DUAN Chong-gang1\*1 Shandong Academy of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Key Laboratory for Chemical Drug Research of Shandong Province, Jinan 250101;2 Quarry Health Pharmacy Co., Ltd., Rizhao Economic and Technological Development Zone, Rizhao 276826 ABSTRACT Objective : To investigate potential interaction between verapamil and curculigoside. M ethods : Twenty-four rats were randomized to two groups (twelve rats in each group), including the curculigoside-only group (A) and the curculigoide and verapamil group (B).
